title: Response board zoom: cursor-centered wheel/pinch + keyboard + reset, logical coordinates unchanged
outcome:
GREG REQUEST 2026-08-01: 'zoom in/zoom out is missing, can we do that?' YES — v1 deliberately stored logical x/y and renders transform-ready so zoom is additive (recorded in tm-7cu.19's deferred list).

SPEC: wheel/trackpad pinch zoom (ctrl+wheel per canvas convention) centered on the CURSOR position, plus keyboard Cmd/Ctrl+= / Cmd/Ctrl+- and a small +/- control with a reset-to-100% affordance. Range ~25%-200%, step smooth. Implementation: single CSS transform (scale) on the canvas content layer with pan offsets composed in the same transform — logical card coordinates unchanged (positions persist zoom-agnostically; PATCH payloads stay in logical space). Hit-testing and drag deltas divide by scale. Zoom level is view state: persist per-board client-side (localStorage) — it is not board data, so no API change.

ACCEPTANCE: zoom at cursor keeps the point under the cursor stationary; dragging a card at 50% zoom moves it 1:1 with the cursor (delta/scale correct); positions saved at any zoom reload identically at any other zoom; text remains crisp (transform, not font scaling tricks); pan+zoom compose without drift. Wide-content-in-card and grid-blowout guards unaffected.
